WITH status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    s.healtheval,
    AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) as avg_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT scans.zoneref) as distinct_sites
  FROM scans
  INNER JOIN sites s ON scans.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin > 0
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) as overall_rate
  FROM status_stats
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.avg_rate,
    ss.distinct_sites,
    oa.overall_rate
  FROM status_stats ss
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE oa.overall_rate IS NOT NULL AND ss.avg_rate > oa.overall_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_rate) as average_rate,
  AVG(distinct_sites) as average_distinct_sites,
  AVG(avg_rate - overall_rate) as average_excess
FROM above_avg
